display_name: Roundhill T-REX 2X Long DRAM Daily Target ETF

about.en: RAM is the Roundhill T-REX 2X Long DRAM Daily Target ETF, a leveraged exchange-traded fund listed on Cboe BZX since June 2026 that seeks twice (200%) the daily performance of the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM), an ETF of memory-technology companies, before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns over periods longer than one day can differ substantially from twice DRAM's performance.
